book.name: Mwɛɛm mvù Jisos to duŋcɛɛ
book.title: Ŋwa' Mwɛɛm mvù Jisos to duŋcɛɛ ɛ̂ Jon

content: Ɛ bó toŋ soŋ yi bokaŋ botin
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ botin toŋ ye soŋ, ɛ me n'yɛn jon mi le ɛ yí to nɛ fowe gbwe fokuse. Ɛ bó nya ken'yene ɛ̂ jon yidvu kè yen'yi kentuke kè shiile nɛn ŋooŋŋ e.
Ɛ jon yidvu mum yene diuw kentuke kedvu, ɛ njiim buy jó nɛn kemm, kɛ yí buy ɛ̂ mwɛɛm e fò bó ɛ kfum. Ɛ njiim yì buyɛɛ ɛ̂ kentuke kedvu le ge ɛ diuu bô ɛbulɛ nɛ no yiile lo.
Ɛ cúma buy ɛ̂ njiim yidvu le shii yî nshɛ le. Ɛ bó nya cúma yidvu bô mvuŋgay lɛ yí etawene diɛwɛ boŋgam bo yî nshɛ le,
lew lɛ fo yí ebefe bô mwɛɛm mvù kuu yî nshɛ le, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛgay, kɛnɛɛ bite, kɛnɛɛ naa la, gay lɛ yí enya ŋgɛw ɛ ɛ̀ nu kɛ ɛ̂ kfuu bonyii ba bò nu sɛ bó kɛŋke nciise wvu Nyo' fojise fo bó.
Bó to nu ɛ cinɛ lɛ cúma yidvu enya ŋgɛw ɛ̂ bonyii yî kee le yitin. Geenɛn fo yí eyuwyɛ lo bó kɛ. Ŋgɛw wvù yí to nu keeke enyaa to nu kɛ diɛwɛ wvu ŋgam seke wvú ɛ ta wee le.
Yî kee yi yitin yin e nu ɛ bonyii nu ke egomte kpwe yaa yɛne yí le kɛ. Bó nu ke ebeele keekpwe, ɛ kpwe lewte lo bó.

Cúma yin to nu kɛ diɛwɛ nyámbala yì nu ɛ seyse wase keebuy gbwen jem e. Mwɛɛm mvumew to nu ɛ̂ yí ɛfa diɛwɛ bifo bi bvunfon e bì bó kene bô ketwaa ke bigew e kè yɛɛle, ɛ monshim mobole nu diɛwɛ mo bonyii le.
Yvúw bikuu bibole to nu diɛwɛ yi bokɛnɛ, ɛ bigew bibole no diɛwɛ bigew bi bobvule le.
Yí to kɛŋke ŋgáw ɛ yí nu diɛwɛ ketwaa kè bonyii bo jem e baŋyi gvúw dvú. Ɛ́ yí dioo bile ɛ bibɛ bibole no yole diɛwɛ bikoto nteen bì ɛ̀ guute nyámbala seke bí lewte gbwen jem e.
Ɛ yí kɛŋke diwvunte bô gɛɛŋ diɛwɛ boŋgam e. Ɛ mvuŋgay mvubole mvù bó nyaa ŋgɛw dvú ɛ̂ bonyii yî kee yi yitin e nu ɛ ɛ̀ nu yî diwvunte din e.
Bó to kɛŋke nfon wvubo ɛ ɛ̀ nu nceendaa wvù taale fô kentuke kè shiile nɛn ŋooŋŋ e kiɛ, ɛ diee diew nu ɛ̂ díɛw Ibulu le lɛ Abadon, nu ɛ̂ díɛw Glek e lɛ, Abolion (ɛ diee din nu lɛ wee wvù beete lo).
Wvun wvù fey bɛɛ ŋgɛw wvu fwe. Geenɛn ben eyekɛ eyuw, bomew boŋgɛw bɛɛ bii ɛjim bofɛɛ.
Ɛ bó toŋ soŋ yi bokaŋ bosoocaan
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bosoocaan toŋ ye soŋ, ɛ me n'yuw ɛ diɛw buy fô bitoŋ bi binɛw bì ɛ̀ nu bi ketaŋ ke ncese le kè bó kene bô ketwaa ke bigew e kè yɛɛle, kè nu fwe dvu Nyo',
jemyi ɛ̂ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bosoocaan wvù to kɛŋke soŋ wɛ lɛ, “Fayɛ bonceendaa bo bonɛw bò bó nu ɛ kay mbew joo yì kuuke yì Yuflɛts e.”

Nonɛn, ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvudvu mum fay bonceendaa bo bonɛw bodvu. Bonceendaa bodvu nu ɛ bó to seyse gɛɛ no cɛyte kefew bô diuu noo kpwee bô kelum kè bó nu ke efay bó, ɛ́ bó eyuwyɛ keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo bitɛte bi bonyii le.
Me nto nu ɛ n'yuw no ŋgoo bonyii bo jem e bo yî nyámbala le nu. Bó to nu bomala gee fɛɛ (200,000,000).

Nyámbala yì me nto n'yɛnɛɛ ɛ̂ fiɛɛ diɛwɛ ɛfilɛ le fiɛ bô bonyii bò to benɛɛ yî dvú le to nu ɛ̂ yin je le: bonyii bodvu to nu ɛ jise bitwaa baŋ gvúw dvú ɛ ncom wvudvu yɛɛle diɛwɛ ŋguy e, bvuu nu diɛwɛ ɛbulɛ le, bvuu nu tɛn diɛwɛ fiŋgɛŋgɛ le. Bikuu bi nyámbala yidvu le to fieesene bi bobvule le, ɛ ŋguy bô njiim noo fiɛɛ fimew diɛwɛ mvuŋkaŋ mvù bɛɛnci le, buyte ɛ̂ yí ɛmvu.
Mwɛɛm mvu boŋgɛw e mvun mvù ɛ̀ to nu, ŋguy bô njiim noo fiɛɛ diɛwɛ mvuŋkaŋ mvù bɛɛnci le, mvù to buyte ɛ̂ nyámbala yidvu ɛmvu to nu ɛ yu bonyii keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo bitɛte.
Mvuŋgay mvu nyámbala yidvu le nu ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛmvu jo yí bô yî diwvunte diyile. Diwvunte diyile nu diɛwɛ yó le kɛŋke bikuu, ɛ ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì yí lɛmse bonyii dvú.

Naa no fí to kooyɛɛ nonɛn, kebɛse ke bonyii le kè mwɛɛm mvu boŋgɛw e mvun to baa yuwyɛ bó, to baa cim ekumɛn mvuntelem mvubole yî mwɛɛm mvù bó to gee bô can yibole kɛ. Bó to baa kumɛn keebunlee bonceendaa bo dɛwle le bô mvumooso kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu mvù bó kene bô ketwaa ke bigew e kè yɛɛle kɛnɛɛ kè baa kɛnɛɛ bô ketfu kè nɛɛ, kɛnɛɛ ɛta, kɛnɛɛ kete. Ɛ mvumooso mvun nu sɛ mvú nulo eyɛn fiɛɛ le kɛnɛɛ eyuw kɛnɛɛ elɛn.
Bó to baa cim kumɛn tɛn mvuntelem keeyuwyi bonyii kɛnɛɛ keegee nfim kɛnɛɛ cee nce nnyɛn kenjaŋ kɛnɛɛ coŋene kɛ.
